WITH top_coop_users AS ( SELECT coop_user_id, AVG(avg_rating) AS overall_avg FROM tb_group_rating
GROUP BY coop_user_id ORDER BY overall_avg DESC LIMIT #{topN} ) SELECT tgr.id AS id, tgr.group_id AS groupId, tgr.rater_id AS raterId, tgr.rater_type AS raterType, tgr.coop_user_id AS coopUserId, tgr.coop_user_name AS coopUserName, tgr.rating_details AS ratingDetails, tgr.avg_rating AS avgRating, tgr.gmt_created AS gmtCreated, tcg.department_id AS departmentId FROM tb_group_rating tgr LEFT JOIN tb_create_group tcg ON tgr.group_id = tcg.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_group_extends tge ON tgr.group_id = tge.group_id LEFT JOIN tb_group_tag tgt ON tgr.group_id = tgt.group_id AND tgt.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_tags tt ON tgt.tag_id = tt.id AND tt.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN top_coop_users top ON t.coop_user_id = top.coop_user_id
